result.reason: The operative language reaches the preferred position for this perpetual, royalty-free licence: it covers Affiliates and contractors acting on Company’s behalf, makes the licence perpetual and irrevocable, and permits transfer to a successor in an M&A transaction without consent. The changes are targeted and preserve the existing use rights and general nonassignment provision. Drafting is generally professional, though the inherited phrase “create, derivative version” should be corrected to “create derivative versions of,” and “non- exclusive” should be “non-exclusive.”
